correctness.rationale: Explicit graph definition and exact all-subset enumeration give dual f-vector (13,78,143,78). Complete triangle relators kill every generator of \(\pi_1\). Signed integral boundaries obey consecutive-composition zero and admit unit-pivot unimodular reductions of ranks 12,66,76 with zero remaining blocks; hence dual integral \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z\), \(H_3\cong\mathbb Z^2\) and no other reduced groups. The 3-dimensional simply connected homotopy lemma gives \(S^2\vee 2S^3\). Combinatorial Alexander duality on 13 vertices gives original \(H_7\cong\mathbb Z^2\) and \(H_8\cong\mathbb Z\). The original cut complex is pure 9-dimensional and therefore nonshellable.

value.rationale: A complete integral and homotopy computation of the dual for the canonical (13,6,2,3) Paley graph, a natural highly symmetric graph beyond the five-cycle base case; identifies two distinct non-top reduced homology degrees and demonstrates nonshellability. The exact finite invariant is motivated by the topology of ordinary three-cut complexes and distinguishes the construction from unrelated Paley neighborhood complexes; no unwarranted infinite family is claimed.
